description: Deterministic local lookup and lexical/field-weighted retrieval index for BlendOps knowledge records, recipes, sources, and skills.

entries.title: Quad-Dominant Subdivision Topology, Pole Routing & Edge-Flow Discipline
entries.summary: Rules for constructing quad-dominant Catmull-Clark subdivision surfaces and deforming meshes, routing 3-edge (N-pole) and 5-edge (E-pole) vertices onto low-curvature planes, and placing support holding loops.

entries.title: Mesh Manifold Integrity, Outward Normals & Applied Scale Hygiene
entries.summary: Foundational mesh hygiene invariants requiring applied unit scale (1,1,1), consistent outward face orientation, merged coincident vertices, and manifold closed volumes before modifiers, UV unwrapping, baking, rigging, or glTF export.

entries.title: Boolean Cutout Shading Cleanup, Custom Split Normals & Smooth by Angle
entries.summary: Techniques for preventing diagonal shading streaks, pinched normals, and bevel overlap spikes after Boolean operations on flat and curved surfaces across Blender 3.6 LTS and 4.1+/4.2 LTS.

entries.title: Non-Destructive Hard-Surface Modifier Stack Ordering & Evaluation Rules
entries.summary: Canonical ordering rules for stacking Mirror, Solidify, Boolean, Weld, Bevel, Subdivision/Triangulate, and Weighted Normal modifiers so hard-surface models remain editable without destructive geometry application.

entries.title: Organic High-Poly Sculpting to Clean Quad Retopology & Detail Transfer
entries.summary: Workflow for transitioning from dynamic-topology or voxel-remeshed high-poly organic sculpts to animation-ready low/mid-poly quad retopology with Shrinkwrap projection and Multiresolution / normal-map detail transfer.

entries.title: Physical Bevel Minimums, Panel Seam Gaps & Industrial Readability
entries.summary: Industrial design rules for sizing edge bevels and panel seams in physical millimeters so specular catchlights and shadow gaps remain legible at camera distance without sub-pixel aliasing.

entries.title: Geometry Nodes Fields Evaluation, Attribute Domains & UV/Shader Persistence
entries.summary: Core architecture of Blender Geometry Nodes Fields, attribute domain interpolation (Point, Edge, Face, Face Corner, Instance), and explicit `Store Named Attribute` contracts required to pass UVs and custom data to shaders and glTF exports.

entries.title: Procedural Collection Instancing vs. Realize Instances Memory & Export Tradeoffs
entries.summary: Memory, draw-call, and export rules governing `Instance on Points` vs. `Realize Instances`, preventing accidental multi-gigabyte mesh explosions while ensuring correct glTF/Three.js instance or merged-mesh output.

entries.title: Poisson Disk Point Distribution, Slope/Altitude Masking & Orientation Alignment
entries.summary: Mathematical and procedural patterns for natural, non-overlapping surface scattering using Poisson Disk minimum-distance distribution, surface-normal dot-product slope filtering, and stable Euler-to-vector orientation alignment.

entries.title: UV Seam Placement, Hard-Edge Splits, Texel Density & Mipmap Padding
entries.summary: Rules for placing UV seams along occluded contours and sharp shading breaks (>=60 degrees), equalizing texel density (pixels per meter), aligning islands to pixel axes, and sizing UV padding margins to prevent mipmap bleeding.

entries.title: Single 0-1 UV Atlas Packing vs. Multi-Tile UDIM Workflows for Offline & glTF
entries.summary: Architectural selection rules between single `0..1` UV atlases (mandatory for standard single-material glTF/GLB web delivery), trim sheets / tiling `KHR_texture_transform` UVs, and multi-tile `1001..100N` UDIM layouts (for offline Cycles VFX).

entries.title: Tangent-Space MikkTSpace Normal & Ambient Occlusion Baking Protocol
entries.summary: Precision baking rules for transferring high-poly or procedural surface detail onto low-poly meshes in Cycles using MikkTSpace (+X +Y +Z OpenGL), fixed pre-bake triangulation, cage extrusion, and 16-bit Non-Color buffers.

entries.title: Principled BSDF v2 Energy Conservation, Dielectric vs. Conductor Albedo & Blender 4.0+ Socket Changes
entries.summary: Physically based shading rules for Blender's Principled BSDF (including the Blender 4.0+ Principled BSDF v2 multi-scatter GGX overhaul), enforcing energy-conserving albedo bounds, binary metalness discipline, and accurate Coat/Sheen/Transmission parameterization.

entries.title: ORM Channel Packing (Occlusion/Roughness/Metallic) & Linear Non-Color Space Discipline
entries.summary: Rules for packing Ambient Occlusion (R), Roughness (G), and Metallic (B) into a single linear RGB texture for glTF 2.0 and enforcing `Non-Color` color space on all non-albedo data textures.

entries.title: Blender Shader Graph to Khronos glTF 2.0 Export Portability & Extension Matrix
entries.summary: Definitive compatibility boundary between Blender-only procedural shader nodes (Noise, Voronoi, ColorRamp, Mix Shader, Shader to RGB, Ambient Occlusion) and the strict Principled BSDF node patterns supported by the glTF 2.0 exporter and KHR material extensions.

entries.title: Three-Point Studio Lighting Ratios, Area Light Angular Size & HDRI Balance
entries.summary: Physically based studio lighting methodology governing Key-to-Fill illuminance ratios (EV contrast), Area light physical size vs. shadow penumbra softness, grazing Rim/kicker placement, and neutral HDRI environment fill.

entries.title: Physical Camera Sensor Size, Focal Length Compression, Tilt-Shift & Depth of Field
entries.summary: Optical rules for selecting full-frame (36mm) equivalent focal lengths by scene domain, preventing wide-angle perspective distortion on products/portraits, maintaining parallel architectural verticals via Lens Shift Y, and calibrating physical f-stop depth of field.

entries.title: AgX vs. Filmic Color Management, EEVEE Next (4.2+) vs. Cycles & Output Bit Depth
entries.summary: Version-aware rendering and color management architecture comparing `AgX` (Blender 4.0+ default) vs. `Filmic` (3.6 LTS default) vs. `Khronos PBR Neutral`, `Cycles` path tracing vs. `EEVEE Next` (4.2 LTS) / `Legacy EEVEE` (3.6 LTS), and 8-bit/16-bit PNG vs. linear OpenEXR output.

entries.title: Armature Joint Hierarchy, Transform Alignment & 4-Bone Linear Blend Skinning
entries.summary: Skeletal rigging invariants for Blender and glTF 2.0: shared mesh/armature world origin with applied unit transforms, separation of deform bones from IK control rigs, consistent bone roll, and normalized <=4-bone vertex weight limits.

entries.title: NLA Action Baking, Constraint Sampling, and Shape Key (Morph Target) Export Rules
entries.summary: Rules for baking IK/constraint rigs into visual FK keyframe clips on NLA tracks and managing Shape Key (Morph Target) memory overhead for glTF 2.0 export.

entries.title: Rigid Body, Cloth, and Physics Simulation Cache Baking vs. Real-Time Tradeoffs
entries.summary: Principles for setting solver substeps, collision margins, and baking Blender physics simulations (Rigid Body, Cloth, Soft Body, Fluid) for offline rendering or keyframe interchange.

entries.title: Volumetric Lighting, Principled Volume, and Real-Time Depth Fog Tradeoffs
entries.summary: Decision rules for using Principled Volume shaders in Cycles/EEVEE versus Mist Pass compositing or lightweight scene fog for web and real-time targets.

entries.title: Modular Architectural Grid Snapping, Pivot Placement, and Real-World Metric Scale
entries.summary: Standardized real-world metric dimensions, modular grid increments (0.25m / 0.5m / 1.0m / 2.0m / 4.0m), and corner/base pivot conventions for architectural and studio staging kits.

entries.title: Foreground / Midground / Background Depth Layering and Cyclorama Staging
entries.summary: Compositional staging patterns for studio cycloramas (infinity curves) and 3-plane environment depth layering (foreground framing, lit midground focal hero, low-contrast atmospheric background).

entries.title: Triangle, Draw Call, Texture VRAM, and File Size Budgets by Target Tier
entries.summary: Quantitative performance budget envelopes across Mobile Web, Desktop Web / E-Commerce Hero, Real-Time Engine, and Offline Rendering tiers.

entries.title: Level of Detail (LOD0–LOD3) Hierarchy, Planar Dissolve, and UV-Safe Decimation
entries.summary: Rules for generating LOD0-LOD3 mesh cascades using Decimate (Planar) and UV-seam-preserving Decimate (Collapse) without destroying UV islands or silhouette fidelity.

entries.title: KTX2 / Basis Universal Texture Compression vs. Draco and Meshopt Geometry Compression
entries.summary: Decision matrix for choosing between Draco (KHR_draco_mesh_compression), Meshopt (EXT_meshopt_compression), and KTX2 (KHR_texture_basisu) based on bottleneck type (network payload vs. GPU VRAM vs. CPU decode time).

entries.title: glTF 2.0 Right-Handed +Y Up Coordinate System and Blender Transform Conversion
entries.summary: Rules governing coordinate axis conversion between Blender (+Z Up, -Y Forward) and glTF 2.0 / Three.js (+Y Up, +Z Forward) along with TRS transform application requirements.

entries.title: GLB Binary Container Structure, Export Flags, and Khronos Validator Compliance
entries.summary: Specification rules for single-file .glb binary packaging (12-byte header, JSON chunk 0x4E4F534A, BIN chunk 0x004E4942), deterministic Blender export settings, and zero-error Khronos gltf-validator compliance.

entries.title: Three.js and React Three Fiber Tone Mapping, Color Management, and IBL Parity with Blender
entries.summary: Rules for matching Blender's AgX/Filmic PBR appearance in Three.js (r152+ / r162+) and React Three Fiber using linear working space, AgXToneMapping or NeutralToneMapping, and HDR Environment IBL.

entries.title: Product Hero Scene & Web-Ready Presentation
entries.summary: End-to-end procedure for planning, staging, lighting, shading, validating, and preparing a single hero product asset for both studio presentation renders and web-ready GLB delivery.

entries.title: Stylized Environment & Establishing Shot Assembly
entries.summary: Structured procedure for assembling a wide environment or small diorama scene with foreground/midground/background depth layering, procedural scatter, and atmospheric lighting.

entries.title: Non-Destructive Hard-Surface Prop Modeling & Shading Hygiene
entries.summary: Structured workflow for creating clean hard-surface props using non-destructive Boolean/Bevel/Weighted Normal modifier stacks, CAD panel detailing, and artifact-free shading.

entries.title: Procedural Geometry Nodes Asset & Scatter Pipeline
entries.summary: Structured workflow for designing parametric Geometry Nodes setups using Fields, named attributes, Poisson Disk point scattering, and safe instancing-to-mesh realization rules.

entries.title: UV Unwrapping, Texel Density & Energy-Conserving PBR Material Preparation
entries.summary: Complete procedure for unwrapping 3D meshes with hidden seams, uniform texel density, mipmap-safe UV packing, tangent-space MikkTSpace baking, and glTF-compatible Principled BSDF materials.

entries.title: Studio Lighting, Physical Camera & Color-Managed Render Setup
entries.summary: Structured workflow for designing physically plausible studio or interior/portrait lighting, calibrating lens focal length and depth of field, and configuring AgX/Filmic color management and render engines.

entries.title: Skeletal Rigging, Skin Weight Normalization & NLA Action Baking for Export
entries.summary: Structured workflow for preparing an armature-rigged or morph-target-animated 3D asset with normalized 4-joint skin weights, baked visual keyframes, and web-ready GLB animation clips.

entries.title: Multi-Gate Scene Quality Inspection, Root-Cause Triage & Correction Plan
entries.summary: Diagnostic and quality-gate procedure that audits an existing or planned Blender scene across geometry, materials, lighting, composition, and performance budgets, isolating root causes and prescribing targeted corrections.

entries.title: Verified Blender-to-GLB Export, Binary Inspection & Web Viewer Handoff
entries.summary: End-to-end procedure for preparing a Blender asset for glTF 2.0 / GLB export, validating binary container structure and Khronos invariants via local CLI tools, and generating Three.js / React Three Fiber viewer integration contracts.

entries.title: Mobile/Web GLB Performance Budgeting, Compression & LOD Pipeline
entries.summary: Structured optimization workflow for bringing heavy 3D scenes and assets within strict mobile/desktop web triangle, draw-call, VRAM, and download-size budgets using material/mesh consolidation, LODs, KTX2 textures, and Draco/Meshopt compression.
